visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of several blocks of white, fuzzy tofu arranged on a bamboo mat. A female vendor wearing a black floral shirt and plastic gloves stands behind a large circular frying pan filled with diced tofu and oil. The background is a busy outdoor street with blurred figures and a green bicycle. (2) The vendor uses a small knife to cut pieces of the fuzzy tofu, picking them up with gloved hands and placing them into the hot frying pan. The camera tracks her hands closely as she interacts with the food. (3) The scene cuts to a high-angle shot of the pan, showing many cubes of tofu frying in shallow oil. The vendor uses long wooden chopsticks to flip the pieces. Above the stall, a large sign with blue and red Chinese characters is partially visible. (4) Multiple extreme close-up shots show the fuzzy tofu blocks on the bamboo mat, highlighting the dense, fine white fibers growing on the surface. The lighting is bright natural daylight, casting soft shadows. (5) The vendor is shown mixing the fried tofu in a stainless steel bowl with a large metal spoon, adding a generous amount of red chili powder, chopped green onions, and liquid seasonings from plastic containers on the counter. (6) A paper tray filled with the seasoned tofu cubes and wooden skewers is held up towards the camera. The camera then focuses on a young man with glasses and a black cap who takes a piece and eats it while nodding. (7) The video concludes with alternating shots of the man talking to the camera and close-ups of the cross-section of a bitten tofu piece, revealing a soft, creamy interior compared to the crispy, spice-coated exterior.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy electronic beat and the curious, inquisitive voice of a young man asking about the fuzzy tofu. The female vendor's mature, professional voice responds warmly over the rhythmic BGM, explaining the preparation method. (2) Discrete metallic clicks and the faint sound of liquid oil bubbling are heard as the vendor moves the tofu in the pan. The primary speaker's vocal pitch is mid-range with high arousal, reflecting genuine interest in the unique food. (3) A sudden exclamation of 'Wow' from the male interviewer marks a shift in excitement. The music continues at a steady ~128 BPM tempo with a strong percussive beat. Ambient street noise is present but kept at a low, non-interfering level. (4) The sounds of a metal spoon vigorously mixing spices in a bowl are prominent, accompanied by the vendor's friendly voice asking for seasoning preferences. The young man's response is short and clear, showing a high level of engagement. (5) The final phase features audible crunching and chewing sounds as the taster tries the food. He speaks with an appreciative, happy tone, describing the flavor profile while the BGM remains upbeat, bringing the audio narrative to a positive conclusion.
